name: Google Pay
tagline: Google's payments app: UPI leader-challenger in India, Wallet globally
facts: Mountain View; India product hub Bengaluru
FY25 ₹1,547 cr India entity (+4%), PAT ₹50 cr
Google India Digital Services Pvt Ltd
Sundar Pichai (CEO); Sharath Bulusu leads Pay product
Google Wallet/Pay in ~80+ countries; NFC cards

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make paying simple, secure and helpful for everyone, anchored in Google's mission to organise information.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be India's default trusted payments and credit layer, and a global wallet for cards, passes and IDs.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Win UPI on simplicity and trust, then layer credit (Credit on UPI, Flex card, loans) via bank partners.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Android distribution, Google brand trust, fraud ML, and Play/Ads ecosystem integration rather than standalone monetisation.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Credit on UPI and partner-led lending; NFC card tap-to-pay testing in India (Feb 2026); UPI Circle for families.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Google Pay barely earns in India; is it a strategic data and Android asset, or should it monetise harder?

customers.pain: Want clean, fast, safe payments without clutter
customers.why: Simple UI, Google trust, strong fraud warnings, rewards and scratch cards

customers.who: Parents, teens, elderly without bank accounts
customers.pain: Dependents cannot pay digitally on their own
customers.why: UPI Circle delegation with limits and approvals, Pocket Money controls

customers.who: Young earners with thin credit files
customers.pain: Card approvals slow; small-ticket credit unavailable
customers.why: Credit on UPI, Flex co-branded card, partner personal and gold loans

customers.who: Kiranas and SMBs via Google Pay for Business
customers.pain: Need free acceptance and visibility to nearby customers
customers.why: Free QR, SoundPod alerts, integration with Google Maps and Business Profile

customers.pain: Need low-cost distribution to digital customers
customers.why: Access to a large engaged base with Google-grade underwriting signals

products.name: UPI P2P and P2M
products.desc: Bank transfers, QR and contact payments

products.name: Bills and Recharges
products.desc: Utilities, mobile, FASTag, credit card bills

products.name: UPI Circle
products.desc: Delegated payments for family members with limits

products.name: UPI Lite and Autopay
products.desc: PIN-less small payments; subscriptions incl. Play Store

products.name: Tap to pay cards
products.desc: NFC card payments, testing in India 2026

portfolio.north_star: Weekly transacting users with successful payments
portfolio.key_metrics: UPI share, success rate, P2M share of volume, retention
portfolio.guardrails: Fraud rate, NPCI 30% cap, complaint resolution time

products.name: Credit on UPI
products.desc: RuPay credit cards and credit lines on UPI

products.name: Flex card
products.desc: Co-branded card for everyday spends, managed in-app

products.name: Personal and gold loans
products.desc: Partner bank and NBFC loans distributed in-app

products.name: Google Pay for Business
products.desc: Merchant app, QR, SoundPod, merchant loans

portfolio.north_star: Monthly active credit users on Google Pay
portfolio.key_metrics: Disbursals, card activations, approval rate, partner revenue
portfolio.guardrails: Delinquency rate, RBI digital lending compliance, mis-selling complaints

products.name: Google Wallet
products.desc: Tap-to-pay cards, passes, tickets, digital IDs

products.name: Google Pay checkout
products.desc: One-click payments on web, Android apps, Play

products.name: Pix and local rails
products.desc: Local real-time rails support in markets like Brazil

portfolio.north_star: Monthly active wallets with a payment or pass use
portfolio.key_metrics: Cards provisioned, tap volume, checkout conversion lift
portfolio.guardrails: Token fraud, issuer coverage gaps, privacy incidents

rows.how: Convenience fee on card bill payments; UPI from bank stays free
Sourcing fees and revenue share on loans and cards
Biller commissions, rewards and offers funded by brands
Indirect: payment data improves Ads, Play conversion via UPI

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: India entity revenue ₹1,547 cr FY25 is tiny versus Google India gross ads of ~₹34,700 cr.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Hundreds of millions use free UPI; banks, billers and a few card-bill users actually pay.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Profit halved to ₹50 cr FY25; UPI processing cost unrecovered under zero MDR.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Credit on UPI, UPI MDR for large merchants, NFC cards, ads and Play cross-sell.

friction: Pending transactions and slow refund resolution
Little human support; chat-bot dead ends
New card-bill convenience fees surprise users
Bank server failures blamed on the app

competitors.label: India UPI
competitors.text: PhonePe (leader), Paytm, Navi, super.money, WhatsApp Pay, BHIM

competitors.label: Credit on UPI
competitors.text: PhonePe, Paytm Postpaid, CRED, bank apps

competitors.label: Global wallets
competitors.text: Apple Pay, Samsung Wallet, PayPal, local wallets

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Android distribution, trust, clean UX, Google ML fraud detection

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: 30% NPCI cap, zero MDR economics, antitrust scrutiny of Google

news.label: Feb 2026
news.text: Began testing NFC card tap-to-pay in India beyond UPI.

news.label: May 2026
news.text: PhonePe plus Google Pay UPI share fell below 80% for first time.

news.label: Feb 2025
news.text: Introduced 0.5–1% convenience fee on card-based bill payments.

news.label: Watch
news.text: NPCI 30% cap deadline 31 Dec 2026; UPI MDR for large merchants.

sources: Google India Digital Services RoC filings FY25, NPCI UPI data, press coverage (Storyboard18, Business Today) 2025–26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
